title: The Book of the Secrets of Enoch
author: Morfill and Charles (trans)
description: The Slavonic Book of Enoch, or 2 Enoch, in the translation associated with Morfill and Charles. It follows Enoch's heavenly journey and presents teachings about creation, the moral life and humanity's place in the cosmos.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/bookofsecretsofe00morf).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
